description:
Interactive formula editor with syntax highlighting, inline validation,
autocomplete for functions and field references, and keyboard navigation.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every keystroke with the updated formula.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the editor should close (Escape, Ctrl+Enter, or outside click).

props.name: fieldNames
props.description: Available field names for autocomplete and validation.

props.name: fieldTypes
props.description: Map of field name to property type (e.g. "number", "date", "text") for type checking.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render inline instead of as a floating dialog. Use this inside transformed containers (e.g. preview canvases).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the anchor element.

description: Read-only formula display with syntax highlighting
